releases.notes:
✨  **Major Improvements**: Added a new language and removed all AI derived works. This release supports Minecraft Versions `1.21`–`26.2`.

**Details**:

- **New language**: @Ferbook3000 contributed Spanish (Mexico).
- **AI removal**: The majority of translations were AI generated and got, due to the lack of quality, removed. The rest of the project didn't use any AI generated assets/works.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nwrenger/disable-dimensions/compare/0.9.0...0.10.0

releases.notes:
✨ **Major Improvements**: Added new languages and implemented a `day` condition (#11). This release supports Minecraft Versions `1.21`–`26.2`.

**Details**:

- **New Languages**: AI-generated translations for Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.
- **Day Condition**: The `day` condition type enables checking the in-game day count directly (#11).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nwrenger/disable-dimensions/compare/0.8.0...0.9.0
